name: Plugin System Loader with Lifecycle & Error Containment
description: Implement Plugin interface and PluginManager supporting register, loadAll, unloadAll, and isolated error handling.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement a plugin management system: 1) In src/plugin.ts, define Plugin interface with name: string, version: string, init(): Promise<void>, shutdown(): Promise<void>. 2) In src/manager.ts, implement PluginManager with register(plugin), loadAll(): Promise<{ loaded: string[], failed: string[] }>, unloadAll(): Promise<void>, and getPlugin(name). If a plugin's init() throws, catch it, record in failed list, and do not crash the other plugins. Ensure test/plugin.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: loadAll initializes plugins sequentially and isolates errors
unloadAll calls shutdown on all successfully loaded plugins in reverse order
constraints: Failed plugin must not prevent subsequent plugins from initializing
